title: Gedion Mutua | Sustainability & Renewable Energy Advocate
heading: WORK EXPERIENCE
introParagraphs: Over a decade of moving between community-facing coordination and technical, finance-facing roles — always at the intersection of clean energy, sustainability and measurable impact.

From regional programme delivery to client relationship management inside a leading bank, I've learned to translate environmental and social goals into language that funders, institutions and communities can all act on.
Below is a closer look at where that experience comes from — the organisations, the timelines, and the skills each one built. Tap any role to see the detail.

roles.title: Regional Coordinator
description: Supports Kenya's off-grid and solar access program as a field officer, promoting solar and clean cooking alternatives in areas like Isiolo, Marsabit, Turkana, and West Pokot.

Acts as a project officer for a NORAD-funded project, targeting startups and SMEs in blue economy, marine litter, renewable energy, and clean cooking under the Financing Innovation N Entrepreneurship (FINE) program.
Implements ESG risk screening and environmental/social safeguards within the group.
Advocates for institutional conversion to clean cooking and solar for heating and lighting.
Supports small businesses in transitioning to solar energy to improve reliability and reduce emissions.
Helps commercial and industrial enterprises adopt renewable energy and energy efficiency to boost production and cut emissions.
Champions tree planting nationwide to increase forest cover, restore degraded lands, and combat climate change.
Serves as a Water, Sanitation & Hygiene specialist, promoting water harvesting, storage, efficiency, treatment, and recycling.
Supports climate-smart agriculture to improve adaptation and resilience for farmers and their value chains.

roles.title: Relationship Officer
description: Supported customer-facing operations at the water utility, handling client queries and account-related requests during the internship.

roles.title: Relationship Officer, Operations
description: Managed bulk transactions as a Corporate Teller, including foreign exchange (FOREX) and money transfers (e.g., MoneyGram and Western Union).
Ensured compliance with regulatory frameworks such as AML and KYC policies.
Maintained meticulous records of all financial transactions in accordance with bank procedures, supporting audit and compliance requirements.
Provided financial advisory services to corporate clients and supported digital banking rollout and customer onboarding.

roles.title: Relationship Officer, Accounts
description: Ensured strict adherence to Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Know Your Customer (KYC) policies, maintaining compliance with regulatory standards.
Achieved 100% compliance with the bank's policies and procedures during account opening processes.
Assisted in end-of-month financial closing activities, ensuring accuracy in taxation procedures.
Facilitated the opening of bank accounts, prioritizing access for vulnerable groups, including orphaned children and the elderly.
